collection.description: A talkative villager assumes their quiet friend is upset because they rarely speak on walks.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A talkative villager assumes their quiet friend is upset because they rarely speak during walks.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The friend explains they enjoy companionship without conversation.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The quiet friend laughs at one story but eventually asks for peace.

c__fx.name: Answer C
c__fx.text: They watch tide pools together, comfortable with different temperaments.
